MOD = 1000000007

def main():
    n = int(input().strip())
    dp = [0] * (n + 2)
    dp[0] = 1
    ans = 0

    for i in range(n + 1):
        for j in range(i, n + 1):
            cur = dp[j]
            if ((i + j) & 1) == 1:
                ans = (ans + cur) % MOD
            dp[j + 1] = (dp[j + 1] + cur) % MOD

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
